notes: Radii must exceed 2^-32. The exact boundary and adjacent binary64 values were passed directly to the public SDK.
Near-equal means abs(radius1-radius0) <= 2^-26 * radius0, distinguished from alternate relative and symmetric hypotheses by 48 threshold cases.
Near-equal radii use unbounded angle * radius / radius0. Unequal radii use a clamped cubic smoothstep from the fixed radius to the rotated radius, including reversed radius order.
Native point commands retain complete source, Copy, grouped Rigid, selection, Undo/Redo, command event and history witnesses. The zero-angle case remains geometrically unchanged.
Tiny and cardinal-angle sine/cosine components are retained by the SDK; the map does not use affine command cardinal cleanup.
SDK invalid definitions return original points. Rust public constructors return errors; the oracle adapter reproduces the SDK point no-op.
No proprietary source inspected. Preserved controls and fitted line contracts have independent Rust tests; native full-geometry and interactive behavior are pending.
The release-mode Python/Rust API replay matches all 108 SDK cases with no native errors; harness timings are not an original native Rhino kernel speed benchmark.
scope: Public MaelstromSpaceMorph point maps and owned Maelstrom point commands. Foundation evidence; command registration, full geometry workflows and UI remain to implement.
